projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort, and EMS risk R857 remains Identified with mitigation not yet arrived.
riskDescription.condition: Further scope additions may exceed the remaining buffer capacity and delay critical milestones.
riskDescription.consequence: UAT sign-off (14 Aug 2026) and Go-Live (2 Sept 2026) could be delayed, impacting client readiness and contractual commitments.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement formal change control board to assess scope impact before acceptance and prioritize critical-path features for Go-Live.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon approval of additional scope changes, defer non-critical features to post-Go-Live phase and escalate timeline impact to client leadership within 48 hours.

riskDescription.context: Data mappings from Data Hub are mostly closed, but possible values for data are still being discussed per Artifacts Decision Log #31 (25 June 2026).
riskDescription.condition: Discrepancies in data values or entity stitching logic may surface during E2E testing or UAT, requiring design changes.
riskDescription.consequence: Rework effort and timeline impact could delay UAT sign-off and compress the window for Go-Live preparation.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct weekly data mapping validation sessions with Data Hub and business teams to confirm entity stitching logic before E2E testing.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once data discrepancies are detected in E2E testing, activate rapid design review with Data Hub team and communicate timeline impact to stakeholders.

riskDescription.context: Citrix server slowness and timeouts are impacting offshore team efforts per ALT challenges and Artifacts challenges (22 July 2026).
riskDescription.condition: Continued Citrix performance degradation may reduce offshore team sprint velocity and delay integration testing activities.
riskDescription.consequence: Integration testing and E2E testing timelines could slip, compressing the UAT window and threatening the 14 Aug UAT sign-off target.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement VDI support coverage during offshore hours and utilize alternative environments for testing when Citrix performance degrades.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When Citrix downtime exceeds 4 hours, reprioritize sprint tasks to non-dependent workstreams and communicate revised testing schedule to stakeholders.

riskDescription.context: 71 functional test cases were executed with a 15% failure rate (11 failed tests) and 1 bug spilled from PI4 Sprint 3 per Artifacts PI04 Sprint 3 Metrics.
riskDescription.condition: Resolution of test failures and bug fixes may consume sprint capacity in PI5 Sprint 3, delaying UAT readiness.
riskDescription.consequence: UAT start could be delayed, compressing the UAT window and risking the 14 Aug sign-off target.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Allocate dedicated sprint capacity for test failure resolution and implement daily defect triage to prioritize UAT-blocking issues.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should test failure resolution extend beyond sprint capacity, defer non-critical test scenarios to post-UAT and notify stakeholders of revised test coverage.

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed 14 scope changes (0.75–1 sprint equivalent effort) under a fixed-price contract of $650,000, and ALT risks highlight agent-related manual effort (Single LLM, Tools integration, Agent learning).
riskDescription.condition: Additional scope changes or increased manual effort due to agent limitations may exceed the available budget buffer.
riskDescription.consequence: Fixed-price margin could erode, requiring internal cost absorption or renegotiation with the client.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish cost tracking dashboard for absorbed scope changes and agent manual effort to monitor margin erosion against contract value.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon margin erosion exceeding 10%, escalate to commercial team and initiate change request discussion with client for additional scope coverage.

riskDescription.context: Software Composition Analysis identified 86 CVEs (4 Critical, 82 High) on the alpine base image per Artifacts PI04 Sprint 3 Metrics.
riskDescription.condition: Pending penetration testing may identify these or additional vulnerabilities as unacceptable, requiring remediation before Go-Live.
riskDescription.consequence: UAT sign-off could be delayed, remediation effort could compress the Hypercare window, and Go-Live (2 Sept 2026) could be at risk.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Upgrade alpine base image to latest patched version and remediate Critical and High CVEs before penetration testing commences.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon pen test identifying unacceptable CVEs, activate emergency patching protocol and escalate to security team for remediation within 72 hours.

riskDescription.context: SAST scans identified 190 code smells (2 Critical, 80 Major, 104 Minor, 4 Info) per Artifacts PI04 Sprint 3 Metrics.
riskDescription.condition: Critical and major code smells may degrade code maintainability and surface as defects or technical debt post-deployment.
riskDescription.consequence: Production support effort could increase, and client satisfaction could decline if quality issues surface during Hypercare.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Remediate Critical and Major code smells identified by Sonar and integrate code quality gates into CI/CD pipeline.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should code quality issues surface post-deployment, allocate Hypercare capacity for hotfixes and communicate technical debt backlog to client.

riskDescription.context: Only one LLM is available in Port Key, which may underperform on specific agent tasks and prevents use of a reviewer-agent per ALT risk.
riskDescription.condition: Agent underperformance in production may require manual intervention to correct outputs or handle exceptions.
riskDescription.consequence: Agent value proposition could be reduced, manual effort could increase, and client expectations for automation may not be met.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Document LLM performance limitations per task type and implement human review checkpoints for agent outputs before production deployment.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When agent output quality falls below threshold, activate manual review workflow and notify stakeholders of reduced automation coverage.

riskDescription.context: Access to Premera Specific Tools (SharePoint, Azure Blob, ADO) for AAVA integration is overdue since 15 June 2026 per Artifacts Dependency #20, and ALT risk highlights Tools Integration as a blocker.
riskDescription.condition: Continued delay in tools integration may limit agent functionality and delay agent-dependent features.
riskDescription.consequence: Agent development and agent-dependent features could be delayed, impacting delivery timelines and agent value realization.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Escalate Premera Tools access request to client leadership and prioritize common tool integration points to unblock agent development.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should tools access remain blocked, develop agent functionality using mock integrations and defer full integration to post-Go-Live phase.

riskDescription.context: ALT risk highlights that inadequate agent hardening may cause inconsistent agent behavior in production.
riskDescription.condition: Insufficient scenario testing or missing fallback logic may result in agent failures or incorrect outputs in production.
riskDescription.consequence: Production instability, user experience degradation, and rework effort could occur, impacting client trust and Hypercare success.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define agent hardening checklist and perform scenario testing with fallback logic before production deployment to prevent inconsistent behavior.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon agent failure in production, activate fallback manual workflow and escalate to development team for hotfix within 24 hours.

riskDescription.context: ALT risk highlights that agent dependency on external tools (AAVA, Premera Tools, DH APIs) may result in execution failures.
riskDescription.condition: External tool or API failures may disrupt agent automation continuity and reduce reliability.
riskDescription.consequence: Automation disruption could reduce agent effectiveness and require manual intervention, impacting productivity and client expectations.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement retry logic and timeout handling for external tool invocations and design graceful degradation paths for agent automation.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When external tool failure exceeds retry threshold, switch to manual workflow and notify support team for tool restoration.

riskDescription.context: ALT risk highlights that poor coordination between multiple AAVA agents may cause workflow delays or incorrect task sequencing.
riskDescription.condition: Inadequate orchestration patterns or workflow monitoring may result in workflow inefficiency or incorrect outputs.
riskDescription.consequence: Workflow delays and rework effort could occur, impacting delivery timelines and agent value realization.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define agent orchestration patterns and implement workflow monitoring to ensure correct task sequencing before production deployment.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should workflow delays occur, manually intervene to correct task sequencing and notify stakeholders of revised completion timeline.

riskDescription.context: Backend unit test coverage is 57% compared to 98% frontend coverage per Artifacts PI04 Sprint 3 Metrics.
riskDescription.condition: The backend coverage gap may leave defects undetected until integration or UAT, requiring late-stage rework.
riskDescription.consequence: Defects discovered late could delay UAT sign-off, increase rework effort, and compress the Hypercare window.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Increase backend unit test coverage to 80% minimum and prioritize testing of critical business logic before integration testing.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should defects surface in integration or UAT, allocate dedicated sprint capacity for backend fixes and communicate revised test coverage to stakeholders.

riskDescription.context: Penetration testing is pending and split into two phases per Artifacts Decision Log #20 and ALT, with 86 CVEs (4 Critical, 82 High) already identified.
riskDescription.condition: Pen test may identify additional security vulnerabilities requiring remediation before Go-Live.
riskDescription.consequence: UAT sign-off could be delayed, remediation effort could compress the Hypercare window, and Go-Live (2 Sept 2026) could be at risk.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Schedule and complete penetration testing by 10 Aug to allow sufficient remediation time before UAT sign-off on 14 Aug.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon identifying critical pen test findings, activate emergency remediation team and escalate to security leadership for approval to proceed within 48 hours.

riskDescription.context: Accessibility testing is in progress with WCAG 2.2 AA compliance required per Artifacts.
riskDescription.condition: Accessibility testing may identify WCAG 2.2 AA non-compliance requiring remediation before UAT sign-off.
riskDescription.consequence: Remediation effort could delay UAT sign-off and compress the window for Go-Live preparation.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Complete accessibility testing by 5 Aug and remediate WCAG 2.2 AA non-compliance findings before UAT sign-off on 14 Aug.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should accessibility remediation extend beyond capacity, defer non-critical findings to post-Go-Live and document exceptions for client approval.

riskDescription.context: Front End, Account Management API, and Wrapper API are deployed to ACPT, but connectivity and service integration issues are being resolved per ALT and Artifacts Key Accomplishments.
riskDescription.condition: Persistent ACPT connectivity and service integration issues may delay E2E testing and UAT readiness.
riskDescription.consequence: E2E testing could be delayed, compressing the UAT window and risking the 14 Aug UAT sign-off target.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Resolve ACPT connectivity and service integration issues by 1 Aug and validate deployment stability before E2E testing commences.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should ACPT issues persist, execute E2E testing in Dev environment and escalate connectivity resolution to client infrastructure team.

riskDescription.context: Production dark deploy is planned with approvals from John's team needed per Artifacts Decision Log #33 (8 July 2026).
riskDescription.condition: Delay in production deployment approvals may compress the Hypercare window or delay Go-Live.
riskDescription.consequence: Go-Live (2 Sept 2026) could be delayed, or the 4-week Hypercare window could be compressed, increasing post-deployment risk.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Align with John's team by 10 Aug to confirm production deployment approvals and release calendar before Prod deploy on 25 Aug.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should approvals delay beyond 20 Aug, escalate to client leadership and request expedited approval process to protect Go-Live date.

riskDescription.context: Data Hub is expected to provide 4 additional fields for total premium calculation by 30 July 2026, with implementation window until 5 Aug per ALT risk and Artifacts Dependency #26 and challenges.
riskDescription.condition: Delay in receiving the fields beyond 30 July may leave insufficient time for implementation by 5 Aug, blocking BoB feature completion.
riskDescription.consequence: BoB total premium calculation feature could be incomplete for UAT, blocking UAT testing and delaying UAT sign-off.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Confirm Data Hub delivery of total premium fields by 25 July and prepare implementation plan to complete integration by 5 Aug.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should fields not be available by 30 July, defer total premium calculation to post-UAT phase and communicate feature limitation to stakeholders.

riskDescription.context: Data Hub support for search by NPN on producer entity is pending with ETA 30 July 2026 per Artifacts challenges.
riskDescription.condition: Delay in Data Hub support beyond 30 July may block producer entity search functionality.
riskDescription.consequence: Producer entity search feature could be incomplete for UAT, blocking UAT testing and delaying UAT sign-off.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Confirm Data Hub support for NPN search by 25 July and prepare integration plan to complete implementation by 5 Aug.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should NPN search support not be available by 30 July, defer producer entity search to post-UAT and communicate feature limitation to stakeholders.

riskDescription.context: Azure 4xx/5xx alerts are currently disabled, and the go-green plan includes updating retry logic to classify invalid email-format failures as non-retryable before re-enabling alerts per EMS.
riskDescription.condition: If retry logic is not correctly updated, false-positive alerts may mask valid failures during Hypercare monitoring.
riskDescription.consequence: Valid production failures could be missed, delaying issue detection and resolution during the critical Hypercare period.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Update retry logic to classify invalid email-format failures as non-retryable and re-enable Azure 4xx/5xx alerts before Hypercare monitoring.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should false-positive alerts persist during Hypercare, implement manual log review process and escalate alert tuning to monitoring team.

riskDescription.context: ALT risk highlights that limited training datasets may delay agent maturity and expected productivity gains.
riskDescription.condition: Insufficient or low-quality training datasets may result in agent underperformance and delayed maturity.
riskDescription.consequence: Agent effectiveness could be reduced, productivity gains could be delayed, and client expectations for automation may not be met.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Curate training datasets for agent learning and implement phased rollout to track agent maturity trends before full production deployment.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should agent maturity lag expectations, supplement with manual intervention and communicate revised productivity gain timeline to stakeholders.

riskDescription.context: ALT risk highlights that unavailability or late discovery of client-specific templates may lead to agent outputs not meeting expected formats.
riskDescription.condition: If client-specific templates are not available or discovered late, agent outputs may require rework to match expected formats.
riskDescription.consequence: Rework effort and delivery delays could occur, impacting agent value realization and client satisfaction.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Request client-specific templates during discovery and validate agent output format standards with SMEs before scale development.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should template mismatches occur, adjust agent output formatting and revalidate with SMEs before next deployment cycle.

riskDescription.context: Auth0 DB connection configuration is maintained outside Auth0, and configuration update in ACPT tenant requires Premera team access (Drew) per ALT risk and Artifacts Risk Register.
riskDescription.condition: Delay in Premera team (Drew) updating the Auth0 DB connection configuration may block ACPT deployment and E2E testing.
riskDescription.consequence: ACPT deployment could be delayed, E2E testing could be delayed, and the UAT window could be compressed, risking the 14 Aug UAT sign-off target.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Coordinate with Drew by 5 Aug to complete Auth0 DB connection configuration update in ACPT before E2E testing completion.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should Drew's availability delay beyond 10 Aug, escalate to client leadership for alternate resource and communicate revised ACPT timeline to stakeholders.
